pkgmetadata.longdescription: The Laya checkpoints (Convai Innovations, Apache-2.0): typed choice, score and yes/no decisions over text in one forward pass, with calibrated probabilities. Pinned to a Hugging Face revision and installed under /usr/share/laya/NAME, where sci-ml/laya's laya-serve loads them with no network. QindaNote's live notes use Laya as the gate that decides when new speech is worth a notes update.

use.flag: Install the English checkpoint (421M parameters, 512 tokens), the default
Install the multilingual checkpoint (322M parameters, 100+ languages, 644 MB)
Install the typed-decisions checkpoint (421M parameters), fine-tuned for typed domain decisions
